highlights.title: Donald Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
highlights.summary: The US president has had a tense and fiery relationship with the US media since returning to office.

highlights.title: Por que a Flórida é o Estado que mais executa condenados à morte nos EUA
highlights.summary: Depois de anos de reduções na sua aplicação, a pena de morte vive novo pico na Flórida durante o mandato do governador republicano Ron DeSantis, aliado de Donald Trump.

highlights.title: Venezuela e oposição negociam enviar aos EUA ouro guardado em Londres
highlights.summary: Metal guardado no Banco da Inglaterra deve ser enviado ao Fed para servir de garantia para empréstimos

highlights.title: Protests Erupt in Nigeria After Police Pack 66 Miners Into One Cell
highlights.summary: Thirty-seven people died in the authorities’ custody, officials said. Survivors said the cell had barely any ventilation, food, or water and people began “collapsing and dying.”

highlights.title: Ex-vereador de SP, Milton Leite se entrega à polícia
highlights.summary: Ex-presidente da Câmara Municipal de São Paulo está envolvido em operação que mira empresas de transporte ligadas ao PCC

highlights.title: UEFA, CONCACAF demand FIFA make $2.1 billion payout to member groups amid funding row
highlights.summary: UEFA and CONCACAF chiefs have urged FIFA President Gianni Infantino to release around $2.1 billion from the governing body's reserves, calling for each of its 211 member associations to receive $10 million over the 2027-30 cycle.
